summary.name: Dockit
summary.one_liner: Dockit is a macOS window management app that docks windows to the edges of the screen using shortcuts or mouse proximity.
use_cases: dock a window to the screen edge with a shortcut
arrange multiple windows side by side on mac
keep a tidy workspace while multitasking
quickly hide and reveal windows at screen edges
summary.what_it_does: Dockit lets you dock the current window precisely to a screen edge with a one-click shortcut. Moving the mouse near a docked edge expands the window, and moving it away collapses it again; dragging can also release it. It can arrange several windows in an ordered layout, and the docking positions and shortcuts can be customized, with window state remembered automatically. The page says it is written in native Swift and uses system APIs to control windows, and that it is MIT-licensed open source.
notable: Mouse-proximity edge sensing expands and collapses docked windows
Native Swift app using system APIs
Customizable docking positions and shortcuts with window state memory
caveats: Only macOS is mentioned as supported
Page states the app is listed as Freeware and Open-Source on awesome-mac, but the page itself gives no pricing details
